Jaishankar Calls for UNSC Reforms, Fair Global Representation for India and Africa

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that India and Africa cannot continue to be under-represented in global decision-making bodies. He called for reforms within the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) to ensure fair representation for these regions.
